verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ixik il winh rey chi', ix wak' pitb'okel spensar winh yet' heb' ay yopisio yet'ok, yik wach' tzin ch'ox juntzanh tas satub'tak tik t'a skal heb',

yik wach' syal eyalan t'a heb' eyuninal yet' t'a heb' eyi he chikin masanil tastak ix aj wixtan heb' aj Egipto tik yet' juntzanh satub'tak ix in k'ulej t'a skal heb'. Icha wal chi' tz'aj eyojtakkaneli to a in ton Jehová in, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi' yilxi winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal a onh hebreo onh tik: ¿Jantakto wal tiempo ol a pitej a b'a, yik max ik'em a b'a t'a wichanh? Aktejel in chonhab' yik b'at och heb' ejmelal t'ayin.
Tato manto ol a chab'at in chonhab' tik, a k'ik'an swik'ankot nok' k'ulub' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' tik.
Ol majel sat lum tik smasanil yuj nok'. Manhxa jab'ok lu'um ol cheklajok. Ol swach' k'uxejb'at nok' jantakto maj lajwokkanel yuj k'een sakb'at chi' yet' masanil te te' satani ol sk'uxpaxb'at nok'.

Ol b'ut'jokkanel yol a despacho yuj nok' yet' yoltak spat heb' ay yopisio het'ok yet' masanil yoltak pat t'a yol yik Egipto tik. Malaj b'aj ix yil heb' he mam eyicham junok icha tik yiktax ix ja kajan heb' t'a jun lugar tik, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh tik winh, ix elixta heb' t'a yol sdespacho winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh rey chi': --¿B'ak'inh ol yaktej juntzanh winak tik onh stzuntzani? ¿Tas yuj max aktejel jun chonhab' chi' yik sb'at och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová sDiosal chi'? ¿Tom max nachajwalel jab'ok uuj, ina toxo ix juwikanb'at ko chonhab' tik? xchi heb'.
Yuj chi', ix awtajxikot heb' chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi': --Ixikek yik b'at ex och ejmelal t'a Jehová he Diosal chi', palta tzeyalkan t'ayin machtak ex ol ex b'at chi', xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi': --Ko masanil ol onh b'atok. Ol kik'b'at heb' kotak unin yet' heb' icham anima, heb' winh kuninal yet' heb' ix kisil. Masanil nok' ko kalnel, nok' ko wakax yet' nok' chiwa, masanil nok' ko molb'etzal nok' ol kik'b'ati, yujto te niwan k'inh ol kutej kik'anchaanh Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh rey chi': --Wach'chom ayoch Jehová he Diosal chi' heyet'ok, ¿tzam he nalaj to ol ex in chab'at yet' eyetb'eyum yet' eyuninal? Manh wal jab'ok. Tob'an chuk tas tze na'a.
Ha exnhej winak ex tik b'at ex och ejmelal t'a he Diosal chi', ina to a jun chi' tze k'ana', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix pechjielta winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ik'chaanh a k'ab' t'a yib'anh chonhab' Egipto tik, yik sjawi nok' k'ulub' ul sk'uxb'at masanil tastak ixto kan yuj k'een sakb'at chi', xchi.

Icha chi' ix aj yik'anchaanh sk'okoch winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yib'anh Egipto chi', ix yak'ankot jun niwan owal ik' Jehová, ix kot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Jun wal k'u yet' jun ak'wal ix yak' jun owal ik' chi', haxo t'a junxo k'ual, a jun ik' chi' ix ik'ankot nok' k'ulub' chi'.
Masanil yol yik Egipto chi' ix majel yuj nok'. Malaj b'aj ix uji junelok yiktax yalanhtaxo, manhxa b'aj olto ujok icha junel tik.

Ix te majel sat lum yuj nok'. Manhxo chekelok jab'ok lu'um. Ha jantakto tas ix kan yuj k'een sakb'at, ix lajwiel yuj nok'. Manhxa jab'ok tas yaax yilji ix kan yuj nok' t'a yol yik Egipto chi', manhxa pax sat te te' yet' schontak te'. Pilan ix lajwiel smasanil, haxonhej ste'al ix kani.
T'a elanhchamel ix awtajxikot heb' winh chawanh chi' yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ix och in mul t'a sat Jehová he Diosal yet' t'ayex.

Tzin tewi t'ayex to tzeyak' niwank'olal t'a in patik yuj in mul tik, haxonhej t'a junel tik. Tze k'anan t'a Jehová he Diosal, yik tz'el jun yaelal to et'jinak chamel ayek' t'a yol in makb'en tik, xchi winh.
Ha wal yik ix elta winhaj Moisés t'a sdespacho winh rey chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot jun ik' Jehová te ow. Ha b'aj sb'at k'u, hata' ix kot jun ik' chi'. Ix b'atkan nok' k'ulub' chi' t'a yol ha' Chakchak Mar yuj, manhxa junok nok' ix kan t'a yol yik Egipto chi'.
Ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh rey chi' yuj Jehová, maj aktajel-laj chonhab' Israel yuj winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Ha tiknaik, ik'chaanh a k'ab', yik wach' sk'ik'b'ik'inal t'a masanil yol yik Egipto tik. Yelxo wal to k'ik' k'inal ol ajok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yik'anchaanh sk'ab' winh chi', ix ja jun niwan k'ik' k'inal t'a masanil yol yik Egipto chi'.
Oxe' k'ual ix k'ik'b'i, manhxa junok heb' syal yilanoch heb' kajan t'a slak'anil, maxtzak yal-laj sb'eyek' heb'. Palta haxo b'aj kajan heb' israel sakk'inal.

Yuj chi', ix awtajxikot winhaj Moisés yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Syal b'at eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová, ik'ekb'at eyetb'eyum yet' eyuninal. Anhej to tzeyaktejkan masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi': Yowalil tzonh a chab'at yet' nok' ko molb'etzal nok' chi', yujto a nok' ko nok' chi' ol kak' ko silab'ok t'a Jehová ko Diosal.

Masanil nok' ko nok' chi' ol kik'b'at ket'ok, manhxo junok nok' ol kaktejkani, yujto t'a skal nok' ol ko sik'el nok' ol kak' ko silab'ok t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ayik manto onh k'ochlaj ta', maxto nachajel-laj kuuj mach nok' ol kak' ko silab'ok chi', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Hanheja' ix pitb'ixiel spensar winh rey chi' yuj Jehová, yik max aktajel heb' chonhab' israel yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Moisés chi': --Elanh t'a wichanh. Manhxo a na'a to swil a sat junelxo t'a tik, yujto ta tzach jawi junelxo t'a wichanh tik, ha t'a jun k'ual chi' tzach chamxonhej, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Ichaton wal tzal chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol wil a sat junelxo, xchi winh.
